meta.textSample: Contrario launches after crossing $6M annualized revenue Solutions Features Customers Domains Resources Sign in Get a demo Back to blogs Better recruiting. Built on Contrario. Category Announcement Posted on May 20, 2026 In under six months, Contrario has crossed $6M in annualized revenue and paid out over $1M to an expert network of hundreds of recruiters. Today, 200+ of the fastest-growing companies, including unicorns like Slash and Wispr Flow, run their hiring on Contrario. We have never had more conviction in the opportunity ahead for Contrario, our recruiters, and our partners. Since day one, our goal has been the same: free recruiters and companies from the repetitive parts of hiring so they can focus on the uniquely human ones. As AI capabilities have expanded, so has our ambition for what recruiting can become. The recruiting inflection point For the last 15 years, recruiting tech got better, but never truly differentiated. From 2010 to 2025, most of the category built SaaS tools for recruiting teams: ATS products, outbound sourcing, and screening software. While each one made existing tasks faster, none fundamentally changed what recruiting looks like. That era is ending. What’s different now isn’t speed – it’s the ability to rely on memory and judgment. The next generation of software can match context, like why they are more likely to accept a certain profile. Or how a company should hire for a new role based on their previous decisions. Agents learn across many company workflows, including: Holding a company's hiring bar deeply enough to recognize shape of a fit Understanding how a candidate grows as a person over time Recognizing when a candidate from a past search is right for a new role The way recruiters work is also changing with agents. Repetitive admin work like sourcing, scheduling, and follow-ups still consumes more than 50% of a recruiter’s time. Agents automate that work away. And now, recruiters can spend time on what matters most: building relationships with people. We're already seeing the early signal of what this looks like. Roughly 30% of hires made on Contrario in the last two months had agents involved, and top recruiters are earning 3x more on our workflows. This is the beginning of a much larger shift in how hiring gets done, and Contrario is the platform behind it. The agent-native recruiter Recruiters in the agentic era look closer to a sports agent: managing high-value relationships and maximizing their candidate’s chances of success. Agents work on their behalf continuously in the background between meetings, during lunch breaks, and while they sleep. For companies, an intelligence layer forms underneath hiring. With every hiring decision, the system learns a company’s standards, patterns behind successful hires, and how quickly they need to move. By the 20th hire, the system understands an organization in ways only a long-tenured employee ever could. We are building toward a world where the pipeline never resets. Where candidates stay in motion across chapters of their career, with context intact. Where companies don’t reset with every new role, because a system already understands them. Where a recruiter walks into every conversation already prepared the way a great agent prepares for the most important meeting of their client's career. So, the next chapter of Contrario is about depth: richer context on every candidate, deeper understanding of every partner we serve, and agents that empower the best recruiters in the world. To every recruiter on our platform, every company that's trusted us with a critical hire, and every employee helping us build Contrario, thank you. Our goal remains simple: help everyone hire great talent faster. Recruiting is being rebuilt and we’re just getting started. meta.textSample: Contrario launches after crossing $6M annualized revenue Solutions Features Customers Domains Resources Sign in Get a demo Shape the future of hiring See open positions Our founding story HQ San Francisco, CA We’re Arya and Aditya, co-founders of Contrario. We started after becoming recruiters ourselves and feeling the pain firsthand. Our early placements ran on WhatsApp threads, emailed PDFs, and messy spreadsheets. We kept asking a simple question: why is recruiting still so manual? Contrario grew out of that frustration: a platform where recruiters can do their best work, supported by modern software and AI tools that improve placement rates and help companies hire faster. Arya Marwaha CEO & Co-Founder Stanford BS (left MS early). Previously built an edtech startup to six-figure ARR, worked in product dev at BCG, and conducted research at Stanford HCI. Aditya Sood CTO & Co-Founder Stanford AI dropout. Led NLP at NASA, published AI research in defense tech, researcher at Stanford AI Laboratory (SAIL) x Anthropic lab. Life at Contrario OUR VALUES 01 Be customer obsessed 02 Low ego and high effort 03 Feedback fuels growth 04 Build as a team Customers and recruiters come first, always. We do whatever it takes to help them win - because their outcomes define ours. Backed by the best Y Combinator (W25) Investor Nexus Venture Partners Investor Jishnu B. (MD, Nexus VP) Investor Goodwater Capital Investor Inventum Ventures Investor Cedric Tempestini (Co-founder, InvestorX) Investor Jerry Cain (Professor, Stanford CS) Angel Abhijeet Dwivedi (Strategic Deployment, OpenAI) Angel David Chen (Algo Trader, Hudson River Trading) Angel Hank Couture (ex-VP, Doordash) Angel Peter Boboff (Managing Partner, Transmedia Capital) Angel Franklyn Wang (CEO, Liquid) Angel In the press Contrario Launches After Reaching $6M Annualized Revenue and Paying $1M+ to Recruiters in Under Six Months May 20, 2026 Read Contrario launches: The case for pairing AI agents with human recruiters instead of replacing them May 20, 2026 Read Contrario, a San Francisco-headquartered recruiting platform, launched with a $2.3 million seed investment led by Nexus Venture Partners. May 20, 2026 Read Company benefits Premium healthcare & 401k We cover 100% of your healthcare premiums: medical, dental, and vision. We also offer a great path to start saving for your future. Competitive compensation We hire the best and treat them accordingly by offering competitive top-tier pay and meaningful equity packages. Bi-annual company offsites Twice a year, we fly the whole team to incredible destinations to reflect on progress, align on our vision, and recharge together. Free lunches and dinners Enjoy healthy catered lunches and dinners, plus unlimited snacks and drinks to keep you energized throughout the day. Gym stipend Receive a monthly wellness stipend to use toward a gym membership, fitness classes, or home equipment to stay sharp and healthy. Flexible PTO We trust you to manage your own schedule. Take the time you need, whenever you need it, to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
